topAttractions.name: Reiek Hill

topAttractions.name: Mizo Heritage Village

name: Odisha

topAttractions.name: Chilka Lake
topAttractions.description: The largest saltwater lake in Asia, known for its migratory birds and dolphin sightings.

topAttractions.name: Puri Beach

hiddenGem.description: A quaint village famous for its traditional pattachitra paintings, a unique form of Indian folk art.

name: Puducherry

name: Punjab

name: Sikkim

culturalFact: Sikkim is home to the Lepcha people, an indigenous tribe that has a unique culture and language, and is known for their expertise in traditional crafts such as woodcarving and weaving.

name: Telangana
